title: Great iced tea maker! Freshly brewed tea in minutes!
text: Great iced tea maker! Freshly brewed tea in minutes!. What an amazing little machine! It seems like within seconds I am drinking my first glass of fresh brewed tea. I used to have a machine years ago where I had to buy paper brew baskets and they used to make such a mess. Not any more with the Mr. Coffee machine since their basket just needs to be dumped of the tea bags and rinsed in the sink. I have nothing but good things to say about this Iced Tea maker. I think this would make a great gift for bride to be, first time homeowner, or someone who just loves iced tea!

product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee 2-in-1 Iced Tea Brewing System with Glass Pitcher, 2.5 quarts
features: 2-in-1 Brewing for fresh iced tea with any flavor tea bags or tea leaves
Fast Brewing Cycle makes up to 2.5 quarts fast and fresh in just minutes
Lift & Clean Filter -Basket with Permanent Filter pulls out and wash off easily
Brew Strength Selector switches up the flavor to strong if you like it bolder tasting
Auto Shut Off powers off tea maker as soon as it's done brewing
Power ON Indicator: lights up to show it's on
Water Reservoir with Window, No overflows! See exact water level as you fill
Water Filtration Ready: Removes up to 97% of chlorine* for better tasting iced tea
* As a result of the Mr. Coffee water filter and brewing process
description: Gourmet-style iced tea has never been easier thanks to the Mr. Coffee 2-in-1 Iced Tea Brewing System. This automatic iced tea maker brews tea bags or tea leaves to your desired strength, thanks to its adjustable Brew Strength Selector. Enjoy creating your own custom-flavored iced tea drinks or follow one of the 20 Mr. Coffee recipes included. Skip the expensive coffeehouse concoctions and enjoy fresh iced tea at home.
